text:
Nikhil,

You’ve been selected as one of the top 12 applicants moving forward. Over 90 people applied for a place on this team, and after carefully reviewing every application, we chose only the highest-ranked candidates.

Your selection was not a coincidence. Your application stood out, and we believe you can contribute to something that has the potential to grow into a significant operation.

I also want to apologize for the delayed response. We needed a call with Upwork to ensure everything was set up correctly, including a proper contract structure that protects both you and us before we proceed. That is the standard we expect from ourselves.

The trial will work as follows:

Using Arden's content, you’ll create 30 to 40 clips according to the brand guidelines already shared in the Notion workspace. Compensation is a flat $4 per clip. If your quality remains strong and consistent, you’ll also receive a bonus, with no cap on what good work can earn.

After all the clips are finished, submit a milestone on Upwork; payment will then be released. The process is simple, clear, and protected for both sides.

Top trial performers will move in-house under a performance-based compensation model that includes bonuses. That is where the greater earning opportunity begins. Consistent delivery can also open a leadership path within the operation, including a base salary and responsibility for managing a team.

What we are building is real, and those who move quickly and execute well will benefit most from joining early.

Are you in?

— Darius
